entries.content: Instant-read thermometers provide temperature readings in 2-5 seconds and are considered essential tools in professional kitchens. Insert the probe into the thickest part of the meat, avoiding bone contact for accurate readings.

Had some pork chops come out a bit pink near the bone last week even though I thought I timed it right. Ended up putting them back in the pan for another couple minutes. Kind of annoying when you think dinner is ready and it's not.
